From Silicon to Intelligence

Capability Statement

Research-driven AI and deep-tech engineering

Download PDFContact the team

Engineering from hardware to applications

Quantquer helps R&D and product teams turn difficult computational problems into systems they can validate and deploy. We start with hardware, data, and operating constraints, then agree on acceptance criteria and deliver maintainable code with engineering documentation.

Hardware

Scope runtime constraints and validation across NPU, GPU, FPGA, and photonic architectures.

Algorithms

Choose models and evaluation methods for generative vision, signals, and decision systems.

Systems

Connect data, models, scheduling, and human review with a traceable record of execution.

Applications

Specify deliverables, integration, workflows, and acceptance criteria for the target environment.

Technical Capabilities

Engagement scope depends on the target hardware, available data, and deployment constraints. These deliverables provide a starting point for a technical discussion.

Semiconductor & Edge AI

Assess runtimes, operator support, precision, and memory for model deployment on edge devices.

Example deliverable Model conversion workflow and target-device test plan.

Agentic AI & Enterprise Intelligence

Build enterprise workflows with source citations, tool interfaces, and human review.

Example deliverable Agent workflow, evaluation set, and error-handling specification.

Industrial Intelligence

Combine facility drawings, equipment specifications, and operating constraints to compare designs.

Example deliverable Workcell layouts, CAD, and a bill of materials.

Healthcare & Neurotechnology

Design workflows for signal processing, EEG analysis, and research validation.

Example deliverable Processing code, evaluation design, and scope documentation.

Financial & Decision Intelligence

Combine dated, traceable financial inputs for reproducible research and backtesting.

Example deliverable Data pipeline, backtest method, and limitations.

Scientific Computing

Build numerical models, parameter sweeps, and sensitivity analyses to test assumptions.

Example deliverable Simulation code, reproducible setup, and validation report.

AI Infrastructure

Design admission control, compute scheduling, performance evaluation, and operational monitoring.

Example deliverable Workload benchmark, deployment plan, and operational documentation.

Equipment Support Knowledge Base

Problem

Approach

Automated Floor Plan Coloring

Problem

Approach
Recognize geometry locally and retain human corrections.
Evidence

Engagement Models

We identify the technical risks and decisions that matter most, then agree on scope, acceptance criteria, and next steps.

Technical Advisory

Get an engineering assessment of an architecture, method, or tool choice.

Feasibility Study

Review data, runtime, and compatibility, then identify a testable technical path.

Proof of Concept

Test a critical assumption in a bounded experiment and document the results.

Minimum Viable Product

Build a core workflow that users can try and evaluate in practice.

Custom R&D and Delivery

Implement, integrate, test, and hand over a system against an agreed specification.

Long-term Engineering Partnership

Support ongoing technical decisions, delivery, iteration, and joint research.
